requirements.title: Brain contract, registries and shared flags
requirements.rationale: Every agent command chooses a brain and a box the same way, so selection errors and the box environment are enforced in one place.

criteria.action: for any Prefix and Task, return from Document() the byte concatenation of Prefix followed by Task
criteria.contract: Document() == Prefix + Task

setup: a zero-value Brief with only Prefix and Task set
check.pseudocode: for p,t in gen_strings(): assert Brief{Prefix:p,Task:t}.Document() == p+t

criteria.condition: a brain name is looked up that is not in the registry (the default registry holds `agentkit` and `scripted`)
criteria.action: refuse the lookup and construct no brain
criteria.contract: *toolio.Failure with category usage (exit 2) whose message lists every registered brain name

setup: the default brain registry holding agentkit and scripted
check.pseudocode: _, err = reg.New("nope", opts); f = asFailure(err); assert f.Category==usage; assert contains(f.Message,'agentkit') && contains(f.Message,'scripted')

criteria.condition: `--budget` is not a finite number greater than 0, or `--max-turns` is below 1
criteria.action: reject the flags before any box opens
criteria.contract: *toolio.Failure with category usage (exit 2) naming the offending flag

setup: a FlagSet with brain.Flags registered using the command's defaults
check.pseudocode: for args in cases: err = flags.Validate(parse(args)); assert usage(err) && contains(msg, flagname)

criteria.condition: `--brain scripted` is given without `--script`, or `--script` is given with any brain other than `scripted`
criteria.action: reject the flags before any box opens
criteria.contract: *toolio.Failure with category usage (exit 2) naming `--script`

setup: a FlagSet with brain.Flags registered
check.pseudocode: assert usage(validate('--brain scripted')) ; assert usage(validate('--brain agentkit --script x.json'))

criteria.condition: `--sandbox` names a provider not in the box registry
criteria.action: refuse the selection and open no box
criteria.contract: *toolio.Failure with category usage (exit 2) whose message lists every registered provider name

setup: the box registry with local registered
check.pseudocode: err = box.Open(ctx, Request{Provider:'podman',...}); assert usage(err) && contains(msg,'local'); assert createCount==0

criteria.condition: a command registers brain.Flags with the documented sandbox default and `--sandbox` is not given
criteria.action: select the `local` provider
criteria.contract: the parsed sandbox value is "local"

setup: brain.Flags registered with the documented sandbox default "local"
check.pseudocode: fs = FlagSet; f = brain.Flags(fs, defaults{Sandbox:'local'}); fs.Parse([]); assert f.Sandbox == 'local'

criteria.condition: a run opens a box with the `local` provider
criteria.action: raise the warning `box_unconfined` exactly once for the run, stating the box has no process or network isolation
criteria.contract: the envelope's warnings contain one entry with code box_unconfined

setup: a real local provider and a temporary git repository
a recording Warn sink
check.pseudocode: With(ctx, req, fn); sess.Sync(); assert count(warnings, 'box_unconfined') == 1

criteria.action: for any selected brain entry, set the box's Spec.Env and Brief.Env to exactly the host values of the names in the entry's BoxEnv and nothing else, with BoxEnv empty for `agentkit` and `scripted`
criteria.contract: with GITHUB_TOKEN, GITLAB_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set on the host, Session.Spec().Env and Brief.Env are empty for `agentkit` and `scripted`

setup: a registry entry with a generated BoxEnv list and a generated host environment containing unrelated variables
GITHUB_TOKEN, GITLAB_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set on the host
a local box on a temporary repository
check.pseudocode:
for names, host in gen(): env = BuildBoxEnv(entry{BoxEnv:names}, host.get); assert env == {n:host[n] for n in names if n in host}
for name in ['agentkit','scripted']: s = open(name); assert len(s.Spec().Env)==0 && len(brief.Env)==0

requirements.title: Opening and syncing the box
requirements.rationale: `git` inside the box is only true when the whole work tree, with `.git` at its root, is synced in, while every git write stays on the host.

criteria.condition: box.Open is called with a HostDir that is the top level of a git work tree
criteria.action: create the sandbox through the named provider with Spec{Env, Labels {af.run_id, af.tool}, TTL}, sync HostDir into it including `.git`, and return a session
criteria.contract: *box.Session whose Provider() is the provider name, Spec() is the created spec and Tools() is the box's tool set

setup: a temporary git repository with one commit
a real RunDir
a counting local provider wrapper
check.pseudocode: s = Open(...); assert s.Spec().Labels['af.run_id']==id; assert ledger kinds == ['box_open','box_sync']; assert ledger[1].head == host.Head()

criteria.condition: HostDir is not inside a git work tree, or is not its top level when both paths are compared after filepath.EvalSymlinks
criteria.action: refuse to open and create no sandbox
criteria.contract: *toolio.Failure with category usage whose message names the work tree's top level when one exists

setup: a plain temporary directory, and a repository with a subdirectory
a counting provider
check.pseudocode: err1 = Open(plainDir); err2 = Open(repo/sub); assert usage(err1,err2); assert contains(err2.Message, topLevel); assert createCount==0

criteria.condition: box.Open creates and syncs the sandbox
criteria.action: record the ledger entries `box_open {provider}` and then `box_sync {head}`
criteria.contract: RunDir ledger.jsonl gains box_open and box_sync entries in that order, head being the host's short HEAD

criteria.condition: the provider cannot create the sandbox
criteria.action: return without a session
criteria.contract: *toolio.Failure with status failed, category sandbox, retryable false

setup: a stub provider whose Create returns an error
check.pseudocode: s, err = Open(stubFailCreate); assert s==nil; assert f.Category=='sandbox' && !f.Retryable

criteria.condition: syncing HostDir into a created sandbox fails
criteria.action: close the sandbox before returning
criteria.contract: *toolio.Failure with status failed, category sandbox, retryable true; the provider's close count equals its create count

setup: a stub provider whose sandbox Sync fails and which counts Create and Close
check.pseudocode: err = Open(stubFailSync); assert f.Category=='sandbox' && f.Retryable; assert closes==creates==1

criteria.condition: Session.Sync(ctx) is called
criteria.action: re-sync the host directory into the box and record `box_sync {head}`
criteria.contract: nil error and one more box_sync ledger entry

setup: an open local session on a temporary repository
a new commit made on the host after the first sync
check.pseudocode: host.commit(); assert s.Sync(ctx)==nil; assert count(ledger,'box_sync')==2; assert boxHead(s)==host.Head()

criteria.action: for any synced session, make `git rev-parse --short HEAD` run through the box's execute tool return the same hash as gitx.Head on the host at sync time
criteria.contract: box output equals (*gitx.Git).Head(ctx) on HostDir

setup: a local session on a temporary repository
host HEAD and `git status --porcelain` captured at sync time
a temporary repository with a generated number of commits
check.pseudocode:
assert exec(s,'git rev-parse --short HEAD').trim()==host.Head(); write(s,'new.txt'); exec(s,'git commit -am x'); assert host.Head()==before && status()==beforeStatus && !exists(hostDir/'new.txt')
for n, branch in gen(): repo = newRepo(n, branch); s = Open(repo); assert execHead(s) == host.Head()

criteria.action: for any commit or file write made inside the box, leave the host's HEAD, branch, index and working tree unchanged and never write the host checkout
criteria.contract: host gitx.Head and `git status --porcelain` are identical before and after; a file written inside is absent from HostDir

setup: a temporary repository and an open local session
check.pseudocode: for ops in gen_ops(): apply(s, ops); assert hostSnapshot()==before && none(exists(hostDir/p))

requirements.title: Session tree access, export and closing
requirements.rationale: Brains read the tree and af places run files through one session, and the box must be closed on every path so no sandbox or export directory outlives the run.

criteria.action: serve FS(ctx) as a read-only fs.FS over the box's read tools in which a missing path gives fs.ErrNotExist and a directory stats as a directory
criteria.contract: fs.Stat of a missing path returns an error matching errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist); Stat of a directory returns IsDir() true

setup: a session whose tree holds README.md and a src/ directory
check.pseudocode: _, err = fs.Stat(s.FS(ctx),'missing'); assert errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist); fi,_ = fs.Stat(f,'src'); assert fi.IsDir()

criteria.condition: WriteFile is called with a path that fails fs.ValidPath or does not lie under `.agent-fox/`
criteria.action: write nothing
criteria.contract: a non-nil internal error (not a usage Failure); the box tree is unchanged

setup: an open session
check.pseudocode: for p in bad: err = s.WriteFile(ctx,p,d); assert err!=nil && !usage(err); assert s.WriteFile(ctx,'.agent-fox/run/r/brief.md',d)==nil

criteria.condition: Export(ctx) is called
criteria.action: export the box tree into a fresh directory named `af-export-<run_id>-*` under os.TempDir, never inside the checkout, and record `box_export {path}`
criteria.contract: the returned directory contains the brain's edits and no `.git`; ledger gains box_export with that path

setup: a local session on a temporary repository with an edit written inside the box
check.pseudocode: d = s.Export(ctx); assert hasPrefix(base(d),'af-export-'+id+'-'); assert !exists(d/'.git') && read(d/'new.txt')==data; assert ledger.last.path==d

criteria.condition: `<dir>/.git` exists after an export
criteria.action: remove the export directory
criteria.contract: *toolio.Failure with status failed, category sandbox, message containing "export carried .git"; the directory no longer exists

setup: a stub sandbox whose Export creates <dst>/.git
check.pseudocode: _, err = s.Export(ctx); assert f.Category=='sandbox' && contains(f.Message,'export carried .git'); assert !exists(dir)

criteria.condition: Close() is called one or more times
criteria.action: close the sandbox once, remove every export directory the session created and record `box_close` once
criteria.contract: later calls return nil and do nothing; export directories are gone

setup: a session with two exports made
check.pseudocode: d1,d2 = export x2; s.Close(); s.Close(); s.Close(); assert closes==1 && !exists(d1,d2) && count(ledger,'box_close')==1

criteria.action: for any outcome of fn (normal return, returned error, panic, cancelled context), close the session before returning, running the close on a context detached from cancellation and bounded to 30 seconds, and re-raise a panic after the close
criteria.contract: With returns fn's error unchanged (or re-panics with the same value); a counting provider wrapper observes one close per create

setup: a counting provider wrapper over the local provider
a counting provider wrapper
check.pseudocode:
for c in [ok,err,panic,cancel]: run With; assert closes==creates; assert result matches c
for outcomes in gen(): for o in outcomes: r = safeWith(o); assert closes==creates; assert r == expected(o)

criteria.condition: closing the session returns an error
criteria.action: raise the warning `box_close_failed` through req.Warn and keep fn's result
criteria.contract: With returns exactly what fn returned; one box_close_failed warning is raised

setup: a stub sandbox whose Close returns an error
a recording Warn sink
check.pseudocode: assert With(fnNil)==nil; assert With(fnErr)==E; assert count(warnings,'box_close_failed')==2

requirements.title: The submit core
requirements.rationale: A refused submission must never exist, so one function is the only path to a submission file and it validates before writing.

criteria.condition: submission.Submit is called with a payload that Kind.Validate accepts and a run.json naming the same kind
criteria.action: write `.agent-fox/run/<id>/submission.json` holding {kind, run_id, attempt, nonce, submitted_at, payload_sha256, payload}, with attempt and nonce taken from run.json and payload the compacted normalised payload
criteria.contract: Receipt{Path, SHA256} where SHA256 is the hex sha256 of the compacted payload and equals payload_sha256 in the file

setup: a tree holding run.json {run_id, kind, attempt:2, nonce:"abcdef0123456789"}
a kind whose Validate returns the payload normalised
check.pseudocode: r = Submit(ctx,target,kind,raw,now); f = read(path); assert f.attempt==2 && f.nonce==n && f.payload_sha256==r.SHA256==hex(sha256(compact(f.payload)))

criteria.condition: the payload is larger than 1 MiB, is empty, or is not a single JSON object
criteria.action: refuse without writing
criteria.contract: *submission.Refused whose Problems name the size, emptiness or shape problem

setup: a valid run.json in the tree
check.pseudocode: for raw in cases: err = Submit(...); var r *Refused; assert errors.As(err,&r) && len(r.Problems)>0; assert !exists(path)

criteria.condition: run.json is missing from the tree or names a different kind
criteria.action: refuse without writing
criteria.contract: *submission.Refused with a Problem naming run.json

setup: a tree without run.json, and a tree whose run.json names kind "other"
check.pseudocode: err = Submit(treeNoRunJSON,...); assert contains(problems[0].Message,'run.json'); same for kind mismatch; assert !exists(submission.json)

criteria.condition: Kind.Validate reports one or more problems
criteria.action: refuse without writing, reporting every problem at once
criteria.contract: *submission.Refused whose Problems contain every problem Validate returned

setup: a kind whose Validate returns three problems
check.pseudocode: err = Submit(...); assert set(r.Problems) == set(validateProblems); assert !exists(path)

criteria.action: for any set of problems, order Refused.Problems by Path and then by Message
criteria.contract: Refused.Problems is sorted by (Path, Message)

setup: a kind whose Validate returns a generated slice of problems in arbitrary order, with duplicates of Path
check.pseudocode: for ps in gen_problems(): r = refused(Submit(withValidate(ps))); assert isSorted(r.Problems, by(Path,Message)) && sameElements(r.Problems, ps)

criteria.action: for any refusal, leave an existing submission.json byte-identical and create no new file
criteria.contract: file bytes before and after a refused Submit are equal; with no earlier file, none exists

setup: a tree with and without an earlier valid submission.json
check.pseudocode: for raw, withPrior in gen_refusals(): before = read_opt(path); Submit(...); assert read_opt(path)==before; assert listdir(dir)==expected

criteria.action: write the file through Target.Write as a temporary file in the same directory renamed over the target on the host filesystem, so a reader never observes a partial file
criteria.contract: no temporary file remains after Submit returns

setup: a Target whose Write is backed by the host filesystem and records each written path
check.pseudocode: Submit(...); assert listdir(dir) == ['run.json','submission.json']; assert json.valid(read(path))

criteria.condition: a valid submission is accepted after an earlier accepted one for the same run
criteria.action: replace the earlier file so the last valid submission wins
criteria.contract: submission.json holds the later payload and the later Receipt.SHA256

setup: an accepted first submission with payload A
check.pseudocode: r1 = Submit(A); r2 = Submit(B); assert read(path).payload==compact(B) && r2.SHA256 != r1.SHA256

requirements.title: The submit command factory
requirements.rationale: `af triage submit` and `af fix submit` must share one envelope contract for a brain with its own hands.

criteria.condition: submission.Command(path, kind) is registered and invoked
criteria.action: read the payload as raw JSON from stdin, take `--dir` (default `.`) as the tree root and `--run-id` opened with toolio.OpenRunDir, and call submission.Submit against that tree
criteria.contract: a toolio.Command whose Path equals path

setup: a toolio App with submission.Command("fake submit", kind) registered
a run directory and a tree dir holding run.json
check.pseudocode: app.Register(submission.Command('fake submit',kind)); code = app.Main(ctx,['fake','submit','--dir',tree,'--run-id',id],stdin,out,err); assert code==0 && exists(subfile)

criteria.condition: `--run-id` is missing or fails toolio.OpenRunDir
criteria.action: write nothing
criteria.contract: envelope status failed, category usage, exit code 2

setup: the submit command registered in an App
check.pseudocode: for args in cases: code = run(args); assert code==2 && env.error.category=='usage'; assert !exists(subfile)

criteria.action: for any tree at `--dir`, open it with os.OpenRoot so that a symlink resolving outside the root cannot be read by validation
criteria.contract: a cited path that is a symlink to outside `--dir` is reported as a problem, not read

setup: a --dir tree containing a symlink whose target is a generated path outside the root (absolute, ../ relative, nested)
a kind whose Validate cites a path and reads it via the tree FS
check.pseudocode: for target in gen_targets(): symlink(tree/'link', target); env = run(payload cites 'link'); assert env.error.category=='submission'; assert !contains(out, outsideSecret)

criteria.condition: the submission is accepted
criteria.action: report the written file
criteria.contract: envelope status done, result {run_id, kind, path, sha256}, artifact {kind: "submission", path}, exit 0

setup: the submit command registered, a run directory, a valid payload on stdin
check.pseudocode: env = run(...); assert env.status=='done' && env.result.sha256==file.payload_sha256; assert {kind:'submission',path:p} in env.artifacts

criteria.condition: the submission is refused, including malformed JSON on stdin
criteria.action: write nothing and keep any earlier valid file
criteria.contract: envelope status failed, category submission, retryable true, result null, error.message naming every problem, exit 1

setup: an earlier valid submission.json
a kind whose Validate returns two problems
check.pseudocode: env = run(badPayload); assert env.status=='failed' && env.error.category=='submission' && env.error.retryable && env.result==nil; assert contains(msg,p1)&&contains(msg,p2); assert read(path)==before

criteria.action: create no run directory, not opt into `--dry-run`, and declare its result schema
criteria.contract: the command's schema appears in `af --schema`; `--dry-run` is not a registered flag of the command

setup: the submit command and an App with it registered
check.pseudocode: cmd = submission.Command(p,k); assert !cmd.UsesDryRun && !cmd.UsesRunDir(create); assert contains(schemaOut, 'sha256')

requirements.title: Placing and running a brief
requirements.rationale: The brain needs its brief and run files in the box, and the run must be observable and its cost recorded whatever the brain does.

criteria.condition: brain.Execute is called, before Brain.Run
criteria.action: draw a 16-hex nonce from Request.Rand and write through Session.WriteFile `.agent-fox/.gitignore` (`*`), `.agent-fox/run/<id>/brief.md` (Document()), `run.json` {run_id, kind, attempt, nonce} and `hook.json` (HookConfig)
criteria.contract: the four files exist in the box via Session.FS with those contents

setup: a local session, a RunDir, a Request.Rand with a fixed sequence, and a stub brain that snapshots the tree via Session.FS when Run starts
check.pseudocode: stub.Run = func(){ snapshot = readTree(sess) }; Execute(...); assert snapshot['.agent-fox/run/id/run.json'].nonce matches ^[0-9a-f]{16}$

criteria.action: for any Brief.Hook, place a hook.json whose protected_paths contains `.agent-fox/`, adding it when missing
criteria.contract: box and host hook.json both list ".agent-fox/" in protected_paths

setup: a stub brain that does nothing
check.pseudocode: for hc in gen_hooks(): Execute(hc); for f in [boxHook, hostHook]: assert '.agent-fox/' in f.protected_paths && superset(f.protected_paths, hc.ProtectedPaths)

criteria.condition: the run files are placed in the box
criteria.action: write host copies `<run_dir>/brief.<attempt>.md` and `<run_dir>/hook.json`, record `brief_placed {attempt, bytes, sha256, prefix_sha256}`, set TranscriptPath to `<run_dir>/transcript.<attempt>.jsonl` and set Observe to emit a `tool_call` event per call
criteria.contract: files exist in the run directory; ledger gains brief_placed with prefix_sha256 equal to sha256(Prefix)

setup: a Brief with Attempt 2, distinct Prefix and Task
a stub brain that captures the Brief it receives and calls Observe once
check.pseudocode: Execute(...); e = ledger('brief_placed'); assert e.prefix_sha256==hex(sha256(prefix)) && e.bytes==len(doc); assert captured.TranscriptPath==rd+'/transcript.2.jsonl'; assert events has 'tool_call'

criteria.condition: the brain is running
criteria.action: emit `step` events for brief, brain and submission, emit `heartbeat {brain, elapsed_ms}` every Request.Heartbeat (default 30 s), and record `brain_start` before and `brain_end {brain, stop_reason, submitted_claim, cost_usd, cost_source, turns, duration_ms}` after Brain.Run
criteria.contract: event stream holds the step and heartbeat events; ledger holds brain_start and brain_end

setup: a stub brain that blocks for several heartbeat periods then returns an Outcome
Request.Heartbeat set to 10 ms
check.pseudocode: Execute(...); assert steps==['brief','brain','submission']; assert count(events,'heartbeat')>=2; assert ledgerKinds contains brain_start<brain_end

criteria.condition: Brief.Timeout is greater than 0
criteria.action: pass Brain.Run a context whose deadline is Brief.Timeout from the start of the run
criteria.contract: Brain.Run observes ctx.Deadline() set to start + Timeout; with Timeout 0 only the caller's deadline applies

setup: a stub brain recording ctx.Deadline()
a fake clock or time bounds around the call
check.pseudocode: d,ok = captured.Deadline(); assert ok && d.Sub(start) within 5s±slack

criteria.condition: Brain.Run panics
criteria.action: recover the panic, write the stack to `<run_dir>/brain-panic.<attempt>.txt` and return without crashing the process
criteria.contract: *toolio.Failure with status failed, category brain; the panic file exists

setup: a stub brain whose Run panics with "boom"
check.pseudocode: _, err = Execute(...); assert f.Category=='brain'; assert contains(read(rd+'/brain-panic.3.txt'),'boom')

criteria.condition: Brain.Run returns, with or without an error
criteria.action: add the Outcome to Request.Tally and call Report.SetUsage with the accumulated total and brain set to the entry name
criteria.contract: usage {brain, cost_usd, cost_source, input_tokens, output_tokens, turns} equals the sum over all attempts so far

setup: a shared Tally and a recording Report
stub brain attempt 1 returning cost 0.10, 3 turns, 100/50 tokens; attempt 2 returning an error with cost 0.20, 2 turns, 10/5 tokens
check.pseudocode: Execute(a1); Execute(a2); assert report.usage == {brain:'scripted',cost:0.30,turns:5,in:110,out:55}

criteria.action: use Outcome only for usage and the claim-mismatch warning, decide whether a submission exists only from the submission file, and parse nothing from the brain's output or transcript
criteria.contract: an Outcome with Submitted true and no valid file yields no Result.Payload

setup: a stub brain returning Outcome{Submitted: true} and writing nothing, and a transcript containing a plausible payload
check.pseudocode: res, err = Execute(...); assert err!=nil && res.Payload==nil && !exists(rd+'/submission.json')

requirements.title: Deciding the submission and the result
requirements.rationale: The host must never trust a brain's claim or a stale file, and every run without a submission must end in a failure category the caller can act on.

criteria.condition: Brain.Run has returned
criteria.action: read the box's `.agent-fox/run/<id>/submission.json` through Session.FS, using a fresh context bounded to 30 seconds when the run context has expired
criteria.contract: the read happens even after a timeout or cancellation of the run context

setup: a stub brain that submits a valid file through the session and then blocks until its context deadline expires (Brief.Timeout 50ms)
check.pseudocode: stub: submit(); <-ctx.Done(); res, err = Execute(); assert err==nil && res.Payload!=nil

criteria.condition: the box's submission.json parses and its kind, run_id, attempt and nonce match this run, payload_sha256 matches the payload, and Kind.Validate accepts the payload against the box's tree
criteria.action: copy the re-validated payload's submission atomically to `<run_dir>/submission.json`, add the artifact {kind: "submission", path} and record `submission_accepted {sha256}`
criteria.contract: Result{Outcome, Payload, Path} with Payload the re-validated payload and Path the run-dir file

setup: a stub brain that calls submission.Submit with a valid payload
check.pseudocode: res,_ = Execute(); assert read(res.Path)==boxRead(); assert artifact('submission',res.Path); assert ledger.last('submission_accepted').sha256==sha(res.Payload)

criteria.condition: the box's submission.json fails to parse, mismatches kind, run_id, attempt or payload_sha256, or is refused by Kind.Validate
criteria.action: raise the warning `submission_invalid` with its problems, record `submission_invalid`, and treat the run as having no submission
criteria.contract: no `<run_dir>/submission.json` is written; warning submission_invalid present

setup: a stub brain that writes the box's submission.json directly as: broken JSON; wrong kind; wrong run_id; wrong attempt; wrong payload_sha256; payload that Validate refuses
check.pseudocode: for c in cases: err = Execute(writeRaw(c)); assert warnings has 'submission_invalid' && !exists(rd+'/submission.json')

criteria.condition: the box's submission.json carries a nonce other than this brief's (such as a file left by attempt 1 read in attempt 2), or no file exists
criteria.action: record `submission_stale` for a stale nonce or `submission_absent` for a missing file and treat the run as having no submission
criteria.contract: no `<run_dir>/submission.json` is written for this attempt; ledger holds submission_stale or submission_absent

setup: a valid submission.json left by attempt 1 (nonce N1) in the box
a fresh Execute for attempt 2 that draws nonce N2 and a stub brain that writes nothing
check.pseudocode: assert ledger has 'submission_stale'; assert !exists(subfile); second: assert ledger has 'submission_absent'

criteria.condition: Outcome.Submitted differs from the host's decision that a valid submission exists
criteria.action: raise the warning `submission_claim_mismatch`
criteria.contract: warning submission_claim_mismatch present in the envelope

setup: stub brains: (a) Submitted true with no file, (b) Submitted false with a valid file, (c) Submitted true with a valid file
check.pseudocode: assert hasWarning(a,'submission_claim_mismatch') && hasWarning(b,...) && !hasWarning(c,...)

criteria.condition: a transcript file exists at Brief.TranscriptPath after the run
criteria.action: add the artifact {kind: "transcript", path} without reading the file
criteria.contract: artifacts contain {kind: "transcript", path: <run_dir>/transcript.<attempt>.jsonl}

setup: a stub brain that writes <run_dir>/transcript.1.jsonl (unreadable mode 0o000 on unix, or large) and one that writes none
check.pseudocode: assert artifact('transcript', rd+'/transcript.1.jsonl') for first; none for second

criteria.condition: a valid submission was accepted and Brain.Run returned an error or a StopReason other than submitted
criteria.action: return the submission as the result and turn a returned error into the warning `brain_error`
criteria.contract: nil error with Result.Payload set; warning brain_error present when Run returned an error

setup: a stub brain that submits a valid payload then returns Outcome{StopReason: "error"} and an error E
check.pseudocode: res, err = Execute(); assert err==nil && res.Payload!=nil && hasWarning('brain_error')

criteria.condition: no valid submission exists after the run
criteria.action: fail with the first applicable case: Brief.Timeout expired; the run context was cancelled or the shell's deadline passed; Run returned an error; StopReason budget; StopReason turns; anything else
criteria.contract: in that order: failed/timeout with fix_hint flag --timeout suggesting twice the value; the context error returned to the shell; failed/brain retryable true; failed/budget retryable false with fix_hint --budget twice the value; failed/budget retryable false with fix_hint --max-turns twice the value; failed/no_result retryable true

setup: a stub brain that blocks on ctx.Done() and returns ctx.Err()
Brief.Timeout 40ms; second case: caller context cancelled; third case: caller deadline passed with Timeout 0
stub brains and no valid submission in the box

requirements.title: The tool gate for in-process brains
requirements.rationale: A denied tool call must never execute, and one rule set must decide for the hook and the in-process interceptors alike.

criteria.action: deny the call without executing it
criteria.contract: tool error result "tool <name> is not in this run's allowlist"; the box tool is not invoked

a spy box tool set that records invocations

criteria.contract: a submit call with an empty Brief.Tools reaches submission.Submit

criteria.condition: a write tool call or shell command targets a path that resolves under `.agent-fox/`

criteria.contract: tool error result naming the protected path; the file in the box is unchanged

criteria.action: return the denial reason to the brain as the tool's error result so that it is the brain's next turn

a scripted script whose first step calls a non-allowlisted tool with expect denied, then a second step that observes the result

criteria.contract: one Observe call and one transcript line per tool call; no transcript field args or result exceeds 4096 bytes

a write_file call with 10 KiB of args and a read_file whose result is 10 KiB

requirements.title: The scripted brain
requirements.rationale: A deterministic replay available in the binary is the offline oracle for the contract test and for `af fix --brain scripted`.

criteria.condition: the `--script` file cannot be read, has unknown fields, has a step with both or neither of `tool` and `submit`, or has an `expect` value not valid for its step form
criteria.action: fail construction before any box opens
criteria.contract: *toolio.Failure with category usage naming the file and step index; the box provider's create count is 0

setup: scripts: missing file; JSON with an unknown field; a step with both tool and submit; a step with neither; a tool step with expect accepted; a submit step with expect ok
a counting box provider
check.pseudocode: for f in files: _, err = reg.New('scripted',Options{Script:f}); assert usage(err) && contains(msg,f); assert creates==0

criteria.condition: Run is called
criteria.action: replay the steps in order on the host, sending tool steps over Brief.Box.Tools() through the tool gate and submit steps through submission.Submit with Tree = Session.FS and Write = Session.WriteFile
criteria.contract: each step's effect is visible in the box before the next step runs

criteria.condition: a step's actual result (ok, error, denied for tools; accepted, refused for submits) differs from its `expect`
criteria.action: stop the replay
criteria.contract: Run returns an error naming the step index, the expected result and the actual result

setup: scripts with a tool step expect error that succeeds, a tool step expect ok that is denied, and a submit step expect accepted that is refused
check.pseudocode: err = Run(); assert contains(err,'step 1') && contains(err,'expected error') && contains(err,'actual ok')

criteria.condition: a submit step is accepted
criteria.action: end the replay and list every remaining step as skipped in the transcript
criteria.contract: Outcome{Submitted: true, StopReason: "submitted"}

setup: a script of a submit step followed by two more tool steps
check.pseudocode: o = Run(); assert o.Submitted && o.StopReason=='submitted'; assert transcript.skipped == [1,2]

criteria.condition: the number of steps run reaches Brief.MaxTurns before a submission is accepted
criteria.action: stop the replay, counting each step as one turn
criteria.contract: Outcome{StopReason: "turns", Turns: MaxTurns}

setup: a script of 5 tool steps and a Brief with MaxTurns 3
check.pseudocode: o = Run(); assert o.StopReason=='turns' && o.Turns==3 && stepsExecuted==3

criteria.condition: the steps run out without an accepted submission
criteria.action: end the replay
criteria.contract: Outcome{Submitted: false, StopReason: "ended"}
